payload.rationale: The document is a minimal test memory by Tanya (staging) verifying that an omitted git ref defaults to creating a topic branch. The active surface already surfaced the core witnesses at witness depth: Actor_Tanya_Staging (the author), Sample_DefaultRefTest (the test memory itself), Narrative_DefaultRefTopicBranch (the narrative about this behavior), Observation_TanyaQuote_DefaultRef (Tanya's verbatim quote), and the style observations (StyleMetrics, TechnicalJargon, DirectTone, FirstPersonQuote) that characterize the document's register. I expanded Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and its four child positions (AntiPatternRealtimeChat, ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, PricingTwelveDollars, TargetMarketRemoteTeams) because Tanya is the CEO and her positioning thesis is the organizational context in which this test memory sits — the passes need to see that Tanya's product vision frames every conversation as producing a persistent decision artifact, which is exactly what the topic-branch default behavior operationalizes. I also included the Sprint 4 retro witnesses (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Position_WebhookArchitecture, Sample_Sprint4Retro, Obs_TanyaThesisProven, StyleObs_Sprint4_DirectQuote) and the product vision sample (Sample_TeamworkProductVision, Obs_TanyaAntiSlackQuote) because they establish Tanya's decision-capture thesis and webhook architecture — the technical and narrative backdrop against which the ref-defaulting behavior makes sense. No areas were deliberately excluded; the document is minimal and the perspective is small, so all load-bearing context was surfaced.
